refsection.title: Description
refsection.para:
The `SilikoSyntaxTreePushLeft` function adds a child to a branch node, to the left of any existing child nodes.
* `BaseTree` is the tree to which the new node is added. * `NewBranch` is the new child node to add.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: `SilikoSyntaxTreePushLeft` returns true if the operation was successful, or false if the insertion failed.
